description: This file provides utility functions for managing Kubernetes node taints, including parsing, validation, addition, removal, and comparison of taints.

methods.name: parseTaint
methods.description: Parses a taint from a string in formats like '<key>=<value>:<effect>', '<key>:<effect>', or '<key>'.

methods.name: validateTaintEffect
methods.description: Validates that the taint effect is one of the supported types.

methods.name: ParseTaints
methods.description: Converts an array of taint specifications into slices of taints to add and remove, with validation.

methods.name: CheckIfTaintsAlreadyExists
methods.description: Checks if specified taints already exist on a node.

methods.name: DeleteTaintsByKey
methods.description: Removes all taints with a specific key from a list.

methods.name: DeleteTaint
methods.description: Removes taints matching a specific taint (key and effect).

methods.name: RemoveTaint
methods.description: Removes a specific taint from a node object.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateTaint
methods.description: Adds or updates a taint on a node object.

methods.name: TaintExists
methods.description: Checks if a specific taint exists in a list.

methods.name: TaintKeyExists
methods.description: Checks if a taint key exists in a list.

methods.name: TaintSetDiff
methods.description: Finds differences between two taint slices, identifying which to add or remove.

methods.name: TaintSetFilter
methods.description: Filters taints based on a predicate function.

methods.name: CheckTaintValidation
methods.description: Validates a taint's key, value, and effect for correctness.
